items.title: What a day at the McClaren Medical Shelter!  If you've driven by lately, you've seen her: a beautiful new sculpture — a...
items.description: What a day at the McClaren Medical Shelter! If you've driven by lately, you've seen her: a beautiful new sculpture — a great ring made of hundreds of hands — now standing proudly in front of this historic building, alongside the brand-new state historical marker telling its remarkable story. From 1949 to 1954, this little brick building was a place of extraordinary care. Black doctors and nurses, shut out of Greenville's hospitals, treated over 1,000 patients and delivered 211 babies right here.

items.title: The Heat Island Effect & Our Urban Future
items.description: I do not have to tell y’all that it is hot out there. Spartanburg, along with many other places, has been experiencing a heat wave with temperatures in the 90s. My phone has had a heat advisory probably every day for the past little bit, and I certainly feel it as I walk and bike all over. Our planet is getting hotter, and a key part of the work that I do is the belief that we can live more sustainably by having dense, urban environments that support more planet-friendly forms of transportation.

In observance of July 4, our building will be closed tomorrow (Friday, July 3). Have a safe and happy Independence Day, Spartanburg!

items.description: At Johnston Design Group, that's exactly how we think about every home we design. A well-managed home doesn't just look beautiful — it performs. It uses energy wisely. It works with the sun and the seasons. It's built from materials that last, selected because they make sense across a lifetime of ownership — not just on closing day. The numbers tell a compelling story: buildings account for roughly 37% of all energy consumed in the United States annually. A well-designed home can cut that impact

items.title: Hub City Hospitality is the team behind Spartanburg favorites Willy Taco - Hub City, Flock Shop, FR8yard, and now, Venus...
items.description: Hub City Hospitality is the team behind Spartanburg favorites Willy Taco - Hub City, Flock Shop, FR8yard, and now, Venus Pie Pizzeria. The team embraces Spartanburg’s rich culinary tradition while creating new dishes and exciting concepts hoping to cater to all tastes. For their contributions to the Upstate food scene, we’re proud to recognize Hub City Hospitality as our June 2026 Small Business Success Awardee, presented by TD Bank.
